description.value: Pokerrito Mount Pleasant is a Pan-Asian poke bowl and sushi burrito chain location in Vancouver's Brewery District, offering over 50 customizable combinations built from sushi-grade proteins, plant-based options, and globally inspired sauces. Situated at the crossroads of Mount Pleasant, Fairview, and Kitsilano, the spot is a short ride from the Broadway–City Hall Canada Line station and easily accessible along the Broadway cycling corridor. It is one of more than a dozen Pokerrito franchise locations across BC and Ontario.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 81m; stands (1 space) at 83m; stands (2 spaces) at 96m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms address (350 W 8th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5Y 3X2) and provides a phone number absent from OSM. Menu pages explicitly mark vegan (🌱) and gluten-free (GF) items, confirming those dietary options. Delivery via DoorDash/Uber Eats/SkipTheDishes confirms takeout; no bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists (604) 326-2765 for this location — OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by website content and OSM record; a convenient stop for touring cyclists on the Broadway corridor.
